content.short: Revolut is a global neobank super app with multi-currency accounts, FX, cards, investing and crypto.
content.description: Revolut, founded in 2015, is one of the world's largest neobanks, serving tens of millions of personal and business customers across the UK, Europe and beyond from a single app. It offers multi-currency accounts, low-cost foreign exchange, physical and virtual cards, savings Vaults, budgeting, stock and commodity investing, insurance and business accounts with expense and payment tools. Revolut also has a large crypto offering, letting users buy, sell and hold digital assets, withdraw crypto on-chain across networks like Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana, and trade through its Revolut X exchange. Holding banking licences in several markets and adding products continually, it works as an all-in-one financial super app.
